claim: Method: all 1,743 reviews read individually in original language (English, Chinese Simplified and Traditional, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Kazakh, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Swedish, Czech, Polish, Arabic) in chronological order, 14 chunks of 125; hand-assigned from an 85-code, 12-family inductive taxonomy (Temp/53-cls, Temp/53-review-classification.py), 3,074 assignments (1.76 per review, median 1); validated 0 unknown IDs, 0 unassigned, 0 duplicate keys, 0 intra-review duplicates, 0 undefined codes, 0 of 85 declared-but-unused; reconciliation exact against 76 by_country files, manifest (1,743; 5:762 · 4:306 · 3:219 · 2:115 · 1:341; mean 3.5927) and _state.json (144 storefronts polled, 76 with reviews, all complete); no deduplication — no title+body pair repeats; a near-identical kr pair (5580879385 1★ / 5580890253 5★, 26 Feb 2020, Family Sharing refund request) kept, the 5★ copy a contradiction; every global % divides by 1,743; signal bands <0.1% ignore · 0.1–0.5% weak · 0.5–1% emerging · 1–3% meaningful · 3–5% very strong · >5% high-priority; text sub-cuts only inside hand-coded themes ('8 am' within REM_CONTROL, dollar figures within PAY_*); every PAY_PROMO, PAY_REGRESS, PAY_CHARGE, STAT_CRASH, BUG_LAUNCH, SUP_BAD, META_CONTRA, HK_WRITE, OUT_MED, OUT_ADHD and PRIV review re-read; no automated classifier; 13 fields, author/app_id/app_name/country_name unused; is_edited 90 (5.16%), 17 say in text they were updated (META_EDIT); vote_count>0 on 360 (20.65%), max 274 (6487531368), never weights; body median 97 characters, mean 165.1

The written corpus is far more negative than the public rating: written reviews are 6.64% of public ratings (1,743 of 26,245) and their mean (3.59) sits 1.01★ below the public average (4.6); in every eligible storefront the gap is 0.75–1.12★ — treat the corpus as the complaint and request channel of a well-rated app, not a satisfaction survey

Review volume collapsed, so late-period rates rest on small samples: 386 reviews in 2018, 115 in 2022, 40 in 2026 (to 19 Aug); eras hold 857 / 524 / 207 / 115 / 40; E4 and E5 shares move 0.9 and 2.5 points per review; 2023–2026 hold 362 in total — trends survive, single months do not

A genuinely multi-market corpus: 76 storefronts, the US 24.56%; 524 reviews (30.06%) in non-Latin scripts — Chinese 299, Japanese 79, Cyrillic 78, Korean 68 — read in the original; nine storefronts clear 50; storefront ≠ language ≠ nationality (English text in cn, Chinese text in us)

No version field and no developer responses in the data — releases, price changes and incidents dated from reviewer text (several reviewers quote replies); no live store page fetched, every price/tier/trial reconstructed from reviews; one external source, habit_apps_ranked.json (undated; public counts, averages, search ranks, market_tier rich/volume); ownership claims in reviews unverified
9.75% of the corpus carries no product experience: META_LOWINFO 161 + META_PREUSE 9 = 170 (mean 4.68); median body 97 characters

No review gating or burst: busiest day 21 Nov 2017 (13 reviews, launch week, the app sat in the App Store's 'new apps we love'); 23 Feb 2019 (9); 20 Nov 2017, 28 May 2018, 24 Feb 2019 (7 each); launch week 16–22 Nov 2017 holds 45 reviews, organic launch traffic from the App Store feature; the 23–24 Feb 2019 cluster (16) spans eight storefronts (ru 5, us 3, ca 2, tr 2, de, kr, jp, lt), 12 of 16 at 4–5★ with varied specific texts, organic; 1,182 distinct review days; no fake-review allegations

When a product stops being maintained the positive themes vanish before the negatives peak: SUP_GOOD 0 after Mar 2022, PAY_ONETIME 0 after Jul 2023, REM_GOOD 0 after May 2024, DES_PRETTY 0 in 2025–26, WATCH_GOOD 4.3% → 0% — while SUP_BAD, PAY_PROMO, STAT_CRASH rose
